Hey there, 

My invitation here is a long-term build, so for any of you looking to find a home this month, this post isn't likely for you. I believe the best way to meet one's needs for community, sharing oneself, connection, safety, warmth, open-mindedness, and responsibility for your own stuff in compassionate, kind relations, is to find others that want the same things and build from the ground up. So I write to you all. 

I'd like to build sharing circles into my new community, deeply supportive (I have the skills to support), coupled with playful times and welcoming people into our space with functions. House meetings for functional stuff, group meals maybe half the time, and beauty. Beauty in connection skills, having each other's back, intimacy and play; functional governance structures, and emotional support. That's hard with our individual lives and work. AND: intention, and dreams, pave the path to discovery. We can find a way if we all want it. Who's interested? 

BTW: I"m in for the long-haul; have the skills to repair; the communication to develop connection; and I'm doing my own work. I have a robust inner-circle of support, and not likely to give that up however good it becomes in a living situation. AND: I want to compliment my life with a foundational home, secure and stable, and warm.  

I really believe NVC consciousness is a core element of the principals I want to build on. So please write a little about your experience with it when you reach out to me. Thanks
